rubrics.justification: Gives a broadly plausible blastocyst description consistent with 3BA, noting moderate ICM and reasonably cellular TE, but includes some uncertainty and minor grading confusion without clearly image-grounded precision.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, semen quality, endometrium, prior cycle history, and smoking well, and relates these factors to prognosis and transfer potential.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are inconsistencies in probability framing and some unsupported statements, especially around the magnitude of smoking effects and fresh vs frozen comparisons.
Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer, smoking cessation, and hydrosalpinx assessment, but includes some less well-supported claims and minor Gardner/grading imprecision.

Provides practical next steps including single embryo transfer, smoking cessation, hydrosalpinx confirmation, luteal support review, and future-cycle considerations, though some recommendations remain somewhat general.
